method: LAION-CLAP (laion/clap-htsat-unfused) embeds 10 s windows every 5 s. score = z(text) + z(taste). text: similarity to four prompts fixed before any result ("Apple iPhone product film music, modern, confident, catchy build" and three more, in clap_rank.py). taste: similarity to the owner's direction, mean of reel tracks 1, 2, 13, 16 minus mean of 3, 4, 5, 6, 8. ref (similarity to 8 Apple and Samsung films) is shown but not used: it ranked his rejected tracks above his liked ones. Tracks already in reels 1 and 2 are left out; at most two per artist. Mixkit was heard from the middle third of each file.
